The *Saddhammantaradhānapañha* ("The Duration Of the Teaching") is a dialogue located in the *Milindapañha* (Mil 5.1.7) [SuttaCentral]. The text discusses issues concerning the disappearance and duration of the true Dhamma, a theme connected in SuttaCentral's cross-references with canonical accounts found in the *Gotamīsutta* (AN 8.51), the *Bhikkhunikkhandhaka* (Kd 20), and the *Mahāparinibbāna Sutta* (DN 16) [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records three modern translations in three languages [SuttaCentral].

It shares an almost verbatim passage (§5.7_1–5.7_2) with the *Mahāparinibbāna Sutta* (DN 16 §5.27.15, similarity 0.97), corroborating SuttaCentral's cross-reference [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. Substantial shared phraseology is also identified across other chapters of the *Milindapañha* (such as Mil 5.1.1, Mil 5.1.5, Mil 5.1.6, Mil 5.4.9, Mil 6.1.1, Mil 6.3.6, Mil 6.3.8, and Mil 6.3.10) and throughout commentarial works, including the *Aṅguttaranikāya* commentary (*Ekakanipāta-aṭṭhakathā*), the *Dīghanikāya* commentary (*Pāthikavaggaṭṭhakathā*), the *Pācittiya-aṭṭhakathā*, and sub-commentaries such as the *Sāratthadīpanī-ṭīkā* and *Vinayasaṅgaha-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. Outside Pali, DharmaNexus automatically aligns passages of the text (§8.1–8.2) with a Tibetan translation in the Kangyur (D0356) that treats prophecies on the preservation and decline of the Buddha's dispensation [DharmaNexus].
